2608.26895.title: When Memory Takes Gradients: Collaborative Vector Memory for Agentic Recommender Systems
2608.26895.paper_summary: Agentic recommender systems ground each decision of a large language model (LLM) in a persistent memory of the user, and in existing agents that memory is text: a narrative written and maintained by further LLM calls. Text limits this memory in two ways. It is updated one rewrite at a time, so exploiting the full interaction history is prohibitively expensive; and collaborative evidence, graded similarity over an entire catalog, does not survive translation into sentences. We propose CoVeMem (Collaborative Vector Memory), which vectorizes the collaborative core of the agent's memory. Frozen LightGCN user and item states form the memory bank; at each decision, the candidate set itself retrieves the most relevant historical states, which enter the LLM's context as soft tokens alongside a light textual profile. Contrastive alignment to item-semantic anchors, followed by listwise co-training with masked candidates, teaches the model to read these states and to rank through them; a pointwise yes/no readout scores each candidate. Across four instruction-grounded recommendation benchmarks, CoVeMem matches or exceeds the strongest collaborative text-memory agent on 19 of 20 metric cells while requiring zero additional LLM calls for memory maintenance beyond the shared static profile, against per-interaction calls for text memory. The memory now takes gradients: the full interaction history, out of reach for text, becomes available as training data for what the agent remembers and for how it reads what it remembers.
2608.26895.paper_summary_zh: 代理推薦系統將大型語言模型（LLM）的每個決策建立在用戶的持久記憶上，而在現有的代理中，這種記憶是文本：由進一步的LLM調用撰寫和維護的敘事。文本在兩個方面限制了這種記憶。它是一次一個重寫地更新，因此充分利用整個互動歷史的成本過高；而且，協作證據，對整個目錄的分級相似性，無法在轉換為句子時保留。我們提出了CoVeMem（協作向量記憶），它將代理記憶的協作核心向量化。凍結的LightGCN用戶和項目狀態形成記憶庫；在每次決策中，候選集本身檢索最相關的歷史狀態，這些狀態作為軟令牌與輕文本輪廓一起進入LLM的上下文。對項目語義錨點的對比對齊，隨後與被遮蔽候選項的列表共同訓練，教導模型閱讀這些狀態並對其進行排名；逐點的是/否讀出為每個候選項打分。在四個基於指令的推薦基準中，CoVeMem在20個指標單元中的19個上與最強的協作文本記憶代理相匹配或超越，同時在記憶維護方面不需要超出共享靜態輪廓的額外LLM調用，與文本記憶的每次互動調用相比。這種記憶現在可以接受梯度：整個互動歷史，對文本而言無法觸及，成為代理記憶及其閱讀記憶內容的訓練數據。
